selection_rule: within each test_year and method, sort by risk_percentile descending then segment_id ascending; select the longest prefix whose cumulative length_m does not exceed budget x total length_m of that year's eligible segments
champion_selection_rule: highest mean capture_at_05 across test years among non-random methods; ties (equal to 4 d.p.) go to the simpler method

aggregation.capture_at_XX: mean across test years (years without recorded breaks are skipped)

uncertainty.method: paired segment bootstrap within each test year; pooled replicates average the yearly replicates

robustness.note: models are fitted on clean training years; only test-year inputs are corrupted; evaluation uses true lengths and outcomes

mask_05.description: Hide 5% of material, diameter, install-year and nearby-break values

mask_10.description: Hide 10% of material, diameter, install-year and nearby-break values

unseen_material_05.description: Replace 5% of materials with a value never seen in training

perturb_numeric.description: Shift install years by up to 2 years and lengths by up to 5%

limitations: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE DATA: these numbers are schema examples, not results. Never show them on slides or in Proof Mode.
Capture counts segments with at least one recorded break in the test year, not individual break events.
A selected segment without a recorded break is an observed non-event, not proof that acting on it was unnecessary.
Results measure targeting quality at a fixed network-length budget, not breaks prevented or money saved.
risk_percentile is a within-year ranking, not a calibrated probability.
The random baseline is a single seeded draw per test year.
Features come from a current-inventory snapshot; pipes replaced before the snapshot are absent (survivorship). See docs/data-card.md.
Validated on City of Kitchener open data only; performance in Malaysia is untested.
